# Test fixtures

Real machine-generated JSON, committed so the corpus is identical on every
machine and in every run. The driver feeds every `*.json` here to the parser
and compares the event stream against Python's `json` module, as it does for
the generated cases.

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `gnatprove-report.sarif.json` | a SARIF log from a GNATprove run on this library, trimmed to 120 results, 40 rules and 80 logical locations |
| `gnatprove-analysis.json` | one per-unit GNATprove analysis record: escape-heavy command lines and long string payloads |

They are here for size, nesting depth and the shapes a generator does not
think of. The hand-written edge cases — escapes, surrogates, number grammar,
truncation — are generated by the driver and do not belong here.

The absolute paths in both files were rewritten to neutral roots — `/opt/gnat`,
`/opt/spark`, `/repo` — because the originals named the generating machine's
home directory. Nothing else was touched: these are still real tool output. If
you regenerate either file, rewrite the paths the same way before committing.

To add one: drop a `.json` file in, run the suite, and say in the table above
what it covers that the others do not. Keep them small enough to read; these
are fixtures, not benchmarks. Do not point the driver at a build tree instead
— that is what this directory replaced.
